Marvel Unlimited is the premier subscription service to access over 30,000 digital comics.

Marvel Unlimited features all of your favorite characters from Marvel movies, TV shows, and video games. Read the comic books that inspired your favorite super heroes and villains on the big screen! Start your free 7-day trial today!

Experience the all-new digital comic format, Marvel’s Infinity Comics available exclusively on Marvel Unlimited. Featuring in-universe stories from top creators told in visionary vertical format, designed for your device.

Read comics and stories about Spider-Man, Iron Man, Captain America, Captain Marvel, The Avengers, Thor, Hulk, the X-Men, the Guardians of the Galaxy, Star Wars, Doctor Strange, Deadpool, Thanos, Mysterio, Ant-Man, The Wasp, Black Panther, Wolverine, Hawkeye, Wanda Maximoff, Jessica Jones, the Defenders, Luke Cage, Venom, and many more!

Unlimited downloads allows you to read as many comics as you want offline and on-the-go! Follow your favorite characters, creators and series and get notified when new issues come out! Marvel Unlimited is available on mobile phones, tablets, and anywhere you can access the web.

Key Features:
• Access over 30,000 Marvel comics at your fingertips

• Endless reading guides
• Unlimited downloads to read anywhere

Choose from three different Marvel Unlimited comic subscription plans as follows:

Welcome to MARVEL SNAP, the Mobile Game of the Year Award Winner, loved by millions of players worldwide. Build your deck and harness the power of different abilities from MARVEL Super Heroes or Villains, and outsmart your opponent in 3 minutes or less with a winning strategy. This fast-paced CCG has weekly updates and cross-platform play, making the card game easy to pick up but hard to put down, whether you play on PC or mobile.

Quickly become the master of the multiverse when you download the fast–paced MARVEL SNAP card game! 

MARVEL SNAP APP FEATURES:

PLAY 3-MINUTE GAMES & WIN IN MARVEL SNAP
- Every game lasts 3 minutes. We cut the fluff to focus on quick games and pure strategy!
- Each player begins with a FREE starter deck that helps you get started on your journey. There are no energy barriers, no ads, and no limits to your play!
- Play card games at your own pace, unlock your favorite MARVEL characters, and discover hundreds of new ones as you earn new cards.

MARVEL CCG WITH VARIETY

- Play with cards at 50+ different locations from across the MARVEL Universe, each with iconic game-changing abilities. 
- From Asgard to Wakanda, new locations are introduced regularly to put your creative problem-solving skills to the test.
- Weekly updates: Access new cards, new locations, new cosmetics, new season passes, new ranked seasons, new challenges, new missions, and new events regularly.

CROSS-PLATFORM PLAY 
- Available on both mobile AND Desktop PC.

BUILD YOUR DECK & COLLECT CARDS

- Collect, mix, and match hundreds of MARVEL hero and villain art variants from the entire MARVEL Universe—and beyond. You might have a classic comic-inspired Iron Man card, but do you also have the Chibi, 8-bit, and Cartoon variants?

I AM GROOT
I am Groot. I AM Groot. I am GROOT. I am Groot? I am Groot. I AM GROOT! I am GROOT. I am Groot? 

DAILY, WEEKLY, & MONTHLY UPDATES
MARVEL SNAP stays fresh and exciting with new cards, new locations, new cosmetics, new season passes, new ranked seasons, new challenges, new missions, and new events regularly. You don't have to wait months for updates! 

What are you waiting for? This strategy CCG game only takes a few minutes to learn and 3-minutes to play. Earn the most power in your location and use a winning strategy to dominate the battle. Download today to see why MARVEL SNAP has won multiple 'Mobile Game of the Year' awards!

results.releaseNotes:
NEW CHAMPIONS
Carina Tivan
After being turned into an ISO-8 crystal and then shattered, Carina Tivan, daughter of The Collector, spent billions of years as innumerable tiny shards scattered far and wide across The Battlerealm. 

Colossus (Age of Apocalypse) [Summoner's Choice]
A Soviet Super Soldier turned steely mutant freedom fighter. In this universe, Piotr Rasputin is a severe and erratic force against the Age of Apocalypse. Life-threatening battle wounds have left him unable to revert to his human form. 

Ghost Rider (Robbie Reyes)
Robbie Reyes is a young mechanic from East Los Angeles who becomes the Ghost Rider after a tragic event leaves him bonded to a powerful supernatural spirit, his late uncle Eli Morrow. 

NEW BOSS
Chronoserpent [Epilogue Boss]
The Chronoserpent claims that they were once the Summoner from another Multiverse who craved power and pierced the dimensional veil to gain first-hand experience of the strength they could only control from afar. This resulted in them recruiting, altering, and empowering the Champions who became corrupted Ouroborus Bosses. 


NEW QUESTS AND EVENTS

Event Quest - Closer To The Edge
Doctor Strange and Spider-Man 2099 have been missing for months, they finally reappear only to notify The Summoner that this twisted Web of Corruption is far from over! It turns out that The Battlerealm itself is splitting apart at the seams and nothing is as it seems. Calling for help results in GHOST RIDER (ROBBIE REYES) and COLOSSUS (AGE OF APOCALYPSE) to get dragged into this Battlerealm bedlam! Hopefully they’ll be able to restore reality and push back this latest wave of corruption.

Side Quest - Symbiote Generals
Your best buddy in the whole Battlerealm THE SUMMONED SYMBIOTE is back and you’ll be running the lil guy through a whole gauntlet of gruesome do-badders. Completing Paths will give the Summoned Symbiote exclusive temporary buffs so that they can take down some of Knull’s Generals who are threatening The Battelrealm. The more fights you can complete, the stronger he can get. Keep fighting until the mild-mannered Summoned Symbiote is strong enough to take down Knull himself!

Epilogue Part 4: Last Struggle
The Quest to reconstruct a 7-STAR CARINA TIVAN and banish the last shadows of the Chronoserpent reaches its climax! Face down inevitable Doom and the Chronoserpent itself to add Carina to your ranks! Bring her for a final battle as you claim all the power you’ve earned.

Venom The Duck Saga Chase
Venom The Duck arrives as a surprise Chase Champion and you’ll need to prove yourself to add this foul fowl foe to your roster. We’re packing 3 months of fun into one so be sure to chase for a 7-Star Ascended VENOM THE DUCK in the final month of this Saga!

Jack O'Lantern and Hobgoblin's Trick or Terror Extravaganza
Log into the Trick or Terror Double Track to earn Trick Crystals that contain Candy Corn and Terror Crystals to reward Recruit Champions. Spend your Candy Corn on exclusive bundles in the Candy Corn Store.

Recruit Ruckus Event
Collect 2-Star Recruits (such as Doombots and Symbioids) to progress their Temporal Collective and ascend the Recruit Tower! Earn Points for the Event by climbing the Tower and completing the regular Battlegrounds Objectives.

Event Tower - Green Goblin (Stellar-Forged)
Earn your Ascension and Awakening for Green Goblin (Stellar-Forged) in this short Tower made just for him!

BIG THINGS is coming back for Season 70
Prepare your best Defenders, and compete against other Alliances to defeat Large Health Pool Defenders in another round of BIG THINGS, coming to you September 23rd!

Towers Update - Auto-Fill Line Up
Based on your feedback we have added a new Auto-Fill button to Towers. This update allows you to instantly populate your line up for an entire Block by simply tapping the new button.

Box Update
Super-Duper Box can now be accessed from the Home Screen!

All this and more! Check out the complete list of updates on playcontestofchampions.com

Collect and battle with over 350 Champions, including your favorite Marvel Super Heroes and Villains like Spider-Man, Iron Man, Hulk, Daredevil, Doctor Doom, Wolverine  & more!

Step into fast-paced 1v1 combat where skill is everything. Master precise dodges, well-timed blocks, and powerful combo chains as you fight your way through an epic Marvel storyline. Unleash signature Special Attacks and dominate real-time battles packed with action.

Assemble your Marvel team and begin your quest to become the ultimate Champion!

THE ULTIMATE MARVEL FIGHTING GAME
Dynamic Real-Time Action & Fights – Dodge, block, and chain combos in fast-paced, action-packed Marvel battles.
Signature Special Moves – Unleash powerful Special Attacks that are unique to every Champion and unlock their Signature Abilities such as Spider-Man’s Spider-Sense, Wolverine’s Cellular Regeneration and Quicksilver’s Super Speed.

OVER 350+ MARVEL HEROES
• Captain America vs. Iron Man! Hulk vs. Wolverine! Spider-Man vs. Deadpool! Professor X vs. Magneto! The greatest battles in Marvel history are in your hands!
• The Collector has summoned you to fight with the biggest Super Heroes & Super Villains from the Marvel Universe!
• Experience the ultimate free-to-play action Super Hero fighting game on your mobile device

BUILD, CUSTOMIZE & UPGRADE YOUR ULTIMATE TEAM OF CHAMPIONS:
• Epic Marvel Action: Assemble a mighty team of Super Heroes and Villains, including Champions from the Avengers, X-Men, Fantastic Four, Guardians of the Galaxy and more!
• RPG Fighting Game: Collect, level up, and manage your teams of heroes and villains wisely to receive synergy bonuses based on their relationship
• Team Customization: Pair up Venom with other Arachnid Hunters such as Vulture or Green Goblin or make a team of Guardians of the Galaxy for a team affiliation bonus.

QUEST, FIGHT AND BATTLE:
• Journey through an exciting storyline full of action in classic Marvel storytelling fashion!
• Embark on action-packed quests to defeat villains like Kang and Thanos and stop a mysterious cosmic threat from destroying the Marvel Universe.
• Fight Marvel heroes and villains across iconic locations like the Avengers Tower, Hell’s Kitchen, Asgard, the S.H.I.E.L.D. Helicarrier, and more.

PLAY WITH OTHERS:

• Partner with another Summoner and take on multiple zones of challenges in Incursions

New This Release

New Raid Auto-Launch
Raids are getting an easier daily launch routine! Starting each day at 1:00 PM (PT), a scheduled Raid will automatically launch for every Alliance—so there’s no need to wait for someone to hit the button or set it up.. Alliances will still choose their preferred Difficulty, but Raids can no longer be launched manually. We’ve also updated the Alliance joining rules: after being in an Alliance for 12 hours, you can jump into any Raid already in progress. Get in, coordinate with your Alliance, and make those daily Raid attacks count!

Bug Fixes
Fixed an issue that could cause players to become stuck during the New User Experience on the homepage, preventing access to game options.
Fixed ISO-8’s Equip All resource list so the highest-value tiers appear first.
Fixed the ISO-8  Upgrade All slider so it defaults to the highest upgrade level affordable with the player’s available resources.
Added missing ISO-8 class names to the Upgrade All pop-up.
Fixed an issue where the ISO-8 Upgrade All pop-up remained open after completing a class upgrade.
Fixed a dead-end UI in Danger Room at Difficulty 6 and higher for players without Rental Packs
Fixed an issue where the defeat marker appeared over the wrong character on the Defeat screen.
Fixed the Not on Cooldown filter in Survival Tower.
Fixed an issue where Alliance damage contribution remained unchanged across Trepidation Raid difficulty levels.
